nodes.title: Paper Dart — Main Design Document
nodes.description: Canonical design: player fantasy, core loop, rooms, controls, simulation model, visual direction, asset list and verification record.

data.text:
PAPER DART — ART DIRECTION

Material: handcrafted papercraft diorama. Everything is card stock: flat cut shapes, visible paper fibre, soft drop shadows, torn and creased edges, faint blueprint grid on walls. The dart is the only object with a real crease highlight.

Palette: paper #F7F2E6, paper-2 #EADFC8, kraft #C08A4E, ink #22303F, ink-soft #5A6B7C, accent #E4572E (power/danger/cold draught), accent-2 #2A9D8F (updraft/success), gold #E9B949 (stars).

Typography: Fredoka for display and buttons, IBM Plex Mono for distance/power/score readouts.

Motion: springy paper, slight overshoot, 220-260 ms eases, numbers tick instead of slide.

Camera: pure side view, dart flies left to right, gameplay band kept clear in the middle of every backdrop. Rooms are 7.5 m tall so a glide has altitude to spend.
data.instruction: Use as the shared style reference when judging or extending any Paper Dart visual.

nodes.title: Art direction card

data.text:
ASSET STATUS

No image or audio generation model was connected while this game was built, so both the art and the sound are produced in code:

- Art: layered papercraft dioramas, props, the dart, pickups and vents are drawn with Phaser graphics and a procedural paper-fibre texture (src/render/*, src/theme.css).
- Audio: every crease, whoosh, chime and the music loop are synthesised with WebAudio (src/game/audio.ts).

The generation nodes on this board keep their prompts, dimensions and shared style so they can be produced and swapped in once a provider is connected. They have no images yet, and nothing in the running game reads from assets/generated/.
data.instruction: Read before promising or judging generated art for Paper Dart.

data.prompt: Game UI screen mockup for a cozy papercraft game titled PAPER DART. A hand-folded paper airplane dart flies across the upper middle over a warm papercut desk scene. Large rounded title plaque of cream card stock with an orange-red accent stripe under it, three stacked paper card buttons, a row of four small paper room cards with star stamps and small readouts along the bottom, a small monospace best-distance tag in the top right. Blueprint grid paper background, soft drop shadows, generous margins, clean uncluttered layout, placeholder text blocks. Handcrafted papercraft cut-out illustration style, layered card stock, visible paper fibre, deep ink-navy outlines, warm cream kraft and orange-red palette, soft diffused light, no photorealism, no watermark.
